title: Total thyroxine (Total T4)

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: T4 is the main hormone made by the thyroid gland. A total T4 test measures the free and bound forms of T4 together in the blood.
context: A T4 result on its own is not enough to identify a thyroid problem, so it is usually read with a TSH test. Some medicines, such as birth control pills and steroids, and some other illnesses can affect the level.
aboveRange: Can be associated with an overactive thyroid (too much thyroid hormone)
May relate to thyroid nodules, a goiter, or too much iodine from certain medicines or seaweed
May relate to taking more thyroid hormone medicine than needed
belowRange: Can be associated with an underactive thyroid (too little thyroid hormone)
May relate to too little iodine in the diet, or to earlier treatment of the thyroid
Rarely, may relate to a pituitary gland problem
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
